en.io: Input is a user requirement beginning with a square-bracket tag and an optional auto suffix. Outputs are pipeline artifacts under works/ and summaries or approval prompts produced by the participating roles.
en.boundary: The evidence defines routing and gates but not the referenced role prompts or artifact schemas. It depends on side effects by multiple agents; automatic mode intentionally removes approval pauses but does not itself define additional safety controls.
dependencies: Specifier, planner, scheduler, builder, verifier, and committer agent roles
An orchestration runtime capable of invoking the roles and pausing for approval
scenarios: Start a new-feature or bug-fix workflow from a leading bracketed tag.
Create a requirement package and pause for user approval.
Run a direct, pipeline, or full execution path selected by the specifier.
Skip approval gates when the request explicitly ends with the documented auto marker.

zh.io: 输入为以方括号标签开头的用户需求及可选 auto 后缀；输出为 works/ 下的流水线产物，以及各角色产生的摘要或审批提示。
zh.boundary: 证据规定了路由和审批门，但未包含被引用的角色提示词或产物模式。该流程依赖多个智能体产生副作用；自动模式会明确取消审批停顿，但未额外定义安全控制。
dependencies: 同级 sdd-pipeline 参考资料，尤其是 references/agent-flow.md
能够调用角色并在审批处暂停的编排运行时
scenarios: 通过开头的功能或缺陷标签启动工作流。
创建需求材料后暂停并请求用户批准。
执行规格角色选定的 direct、pipeline 或 full 路径。
请求以规定的 auto 标记结尾时跳过审批停顿。
